biology_labels.note: patient-level biology labels for H2-C. columns maps output alias -> source column in labels_path. the alias is what the evaluation chain and biology.parquet use; the source column is the clinical file's own name

read_only_inputs.note: artifacts that PRODUCED the published grid. every port in this repo is verified by diffing against them, so they are the oracle and not output. writing into one does not merely lose data - it destroys the ability to verify anything, because the diff then compares a port against its own output and passes.
read_only_inputs.regenerable: virchow2_* and novae_* could be recomputed at cost - about 5.8 hours for the H&E arm. the gpath2vec v1 build could NOT: its inputs were superseded and renamed _v1_legacy.
read_only_inputs.runs_note: the finished run grid is an oracle too: the evidence pack cites its eval/ artifacts and the acceptance pins are diffed against them. a rerun is staged into a fresh out_root (protocols/align.stage_grid) and scores there.
read_only_inputs.v1_note: the last path is v1, not v3. pathway_discrimination is the one task row whose artifact is v1 - the v3 DAG decomposition is deferred - so the file it cites needs the same protection as the v3 grid. only runs/tnbc-92_v3 was covered, and the pack cited outside it.
read_only_inputs.pathway_oracle_note: biological_signals was absent from this list until 2026-10-13 while holding the WHOLE pathway oracle: niche_madmean_genesets.json and its TF subset, the Fisher results and sig rows, both AUCell parquets, and niche_counts_cache_genes.npy - the 41,414-symbol universe every AUCell score is ranked against. a port writing there would have been diffed against its own output and passed. the gpath2vec directory downstream of it was protected; its inputs were not.

join_inputs.note: what the join reads, per sample. transcribed from script_map/build_niche_join.md - the paths are the script's constants at lines 54-63 and the column lists are its own declarations, not inferred.

virchow2_niche.note: pre-pooled at extraction; carried, never pooled again (map row 285)

virchow2_cell_tokens.note: per-unit; stacked centre-first into the token block (map rows 227-228). 280 .npy files and no meta of its own - it shares the niche assay's index, which the script's comment at line 189 states

novae_niche.note: pooled over the neighbourhood, then standardised after the drop

gpath2vec_niche.note: the anchor. non_data_columns is the script's own GPATH_META_COLS at line 71 - selecting by dtype pulls pixel_x/pixel_y into the vector

mc_megacluster.note: keyed by slide position, so the sample id's TNBC{n}_ prefix is stripped - the script's slide_pos() at line 147

mc_weights_niche.note: SUPERVISION ONLY - never a feature. guard G6 asserts it

subject.note: the subject this sample belongs to. the script read it from the same table (line 364, first row per sample) and every split and confounder check is taken on it.
